fromDomain.label: Domain
fromDomain.hint: Anyone at this domain, including its subdomains.

section.title: Rules
section.description: Filters that run on new mail inside Naushen Mail. They are local to this Mac: nothing is created in Gmail, and they don't run while the app is closed.
section.description_outlook: Filters that run on new mail inside Naushen Mail. They are local to this Mac: nothing is created in Gmail or Outlook, and they don't run while the app is closed.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.body: Open a conversation and press <k1>⌘</k1><k2>⇧</k2><k3>R</k3> to file mail from that sender automatically.

section.deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? Mail already filed stays where it is.
section.order: Rules run top to bottom; every matching rule applies.

bundles.title: Inbox bundles

collapse.label: Collapse low-value mail
collapse.desc: A bundled label or sender becomes one row in your Inbox (for example “Newsletters · 7 new”). Starred mail is never bundled. Nothing is bundled until you add one.

bundles.bundleLabelDesc: Or right-click a label in the sidebar.

host.title: Create rule
host.note: Local to Naushen Mail: nothing is created in Gmail.
host.note_outlook: Local to Naushen Mail: nothing is created in Gmail or Outlook.

match.incomplete: Add a value and an action

toast.existedNothing: Rule already existed · nothing needed changing
toast.created: Rule created. It filters new mail on this Mac.

toast.noIncoming: This conversation has no incoming message to build a rule from.

toast.blockedMoved_one: Blocked {{name}} · {{count}} moved to Trash. Future mail goes to Trash.
